title: The Assistant acts as TJ in any session: swap, close and spinoff launch accept a yes it relays (assistant-acts, T-VY8EF)

fields.why: TJ confirmed directly; separate from grid work

text: Do ticket T-VY8EF (genlock show T-VY8EF; TJ's decision is on it). swap checks --user-said at lib/continuity.mjs:307, spinoff launch at lib/spinoff.mjs:262, close lives in lib/overview.mjs. Add a relayed-yes path accepted only from the Assistant session (its channel/token), logged with TJ's words. Add the rule to the Assistant instructions. lib/overview.mjs and tests/run.mjs are held by T-2AAH6 until it finishes.

fields.user_said: you can start both in a new session then

text: A session told by the Assistant to swap does so without TJ typing in that pane: genlock tell --relay-yes leaves a one-use grant in that session's channel, and genlock swap GOAL --relayed accepts it, recording TJ's words and that the Assistant relayed them
check: tests/run.mjs: swap --relayed with a grant succeeds; swap.json and the record carry TJ's words and relayed_by assistant; the grant is used up

text: spinoff launch accepts a relayed yes the same way, and genlock close requires and records TJ's yes
check: tests/run.mjs: spinoff launch --relayed with a grant succeeds and its record names the relay; close without --user-said is refused, with it close.json carries the words

text: A relayed yes is accepted only from the Assistant: tell --relay-yes refuses outside the Assistant, and --relayed with no grant in the session's own channel is refused
check: tests/run.mjs: tell --relay-yes from a project session refused; swap --relayed and launch --relayed with no grant refused; a grant for swap does not license launch

text: The Assistant's instructions say to relay TJ's own words and never invent a yes; project sessions' instructions say how to act on a relayed yes
check: file: app/Sources/GenlockCore/Voice.swift contains the relay-yes rule in the Assistant rules and --relayed in the session swap/spinoff rules

text: Full test suite passes and the app builds
check: node tests/run.mjs exits 0; swift build in app succeeds

text: A grant file in the session's own channel folder is enough proof the Assistant relayed it; only tell (Assistant-only) writes it
breaks: A project agent hand-writing relay-yes.json could fake a yes; same trust level as typing --user-said with made-up words

text: Built: lib/relay.mjs grant (relay-yes.json in session channel, one-use, 2h, per action). tell --relay-yes/--for writes it (Assistant only); swap and spinoff launch take --relayed; close now requires --user-said, written to close.json. Rules added in Voice.swift. App builds. Suite 461/462: one overview test fails ('open question and review wait on the user'), checking on clean HEAD copy. Not committed.

evidence: tests/run.mjs: 'swap --relayed with a yes relayed for it swaps' (swap.json user_said='yes swap it', relayed_by='assistant'), '...records the user's words and that the Assistant relayed them' (project.jsonl swap event), '...and uses the yes up' all pass

tests/run.mjs: 'launch --relayed with a yes relayed for it opens the pane', record fields user_said+relayed_by=assistant, grant used up; 'close needs the user's yes' refused without --user-said; close.json user_said='yes close the side one' - all pass

tests/run.mjs pass: 'a project session cannot relay a yes' (tell --relay-yes outside Assistant, no grant written); swap/launch --relayed with no grant -> 'no yes has been relayed'; swap grant refused by launch ('was for swap'), launch grant refused by swap; 3h-old grant refused; outside app refused

app/Sources/GenlockCore/Voice.swift: assistantRule 'To act for the user in a session' paragraph (--relay-yes THEIR EXACT WORDS, never invent one); swapRule and spinoff step 4 mention --relayed; close carries --user-said

swift build OK (Build complete 22.51s); suite 461/462 with my change. The one failure ('an open question and review wait on the user', overview brief) fails identically on a clean git-archive HEAD copy (442/443), so it predates this ticket; all 19 new checks pass

answers.observed: 19 new checks pass in tests/run.mjs; swift build complete
